title: Shank out: fastener grip against the sourced clamped stack (pitch-link eye excluded)

checks.label: shank out, NAS6403U11D
excluded_terms: pitch-link eye / spherical bearing width -- no document
checks.guidance: clamped column minus grip. Negative means the end of the full cylindrical shank sits proud of the nut bearing face, so the nut would engage incomplete threads -- which JPS00094 Rev C section 5.5.5 forbids outright ('The nut, nutplate, insert, part body, etc., shall not engage any incomplete threads of the bolt shank'). This check carries `complete: false`: the pitch-link eye is missing from the column, so its verdict is scoped to the budget, not to the joint, and the verdict below is not a design conclusion. Read the magnitude instead -- it is the pitch-link eye width the joint REQUIRES. The BINDING requirement is the worst-case end: eye >= 8.1939 mm (grip at max 17.7292 against the column at min 9.5353) to pass worst case, and >= 7.8399 mm to pass at nominal, so an eye between 7.8399 and 8.1939 mm makes this check `marginal`. The other worst-case end, 7.4859 mm (grip at min against the column at max), is the value below which the check fails even in the most favourable combination -- it is NOT the requirement. Sourcing that one number flips this check.

provenance.pinned_by: tests/test_topology_conversions.py -- every field of the folded interval must equal that check's, exactly.

notes: The selection is a lasso, not a path: traverse() re-orders it. The chain walks `fastener_grip` AGAINST its authored orientation (shank_full_dia_end -> head_bearing_face, sign -1) then the three clamped edges WITH their authored orientation (sign +1 each), so the total is `clamped_stack_sourced - fastener_grip` -- the same sign convention the referenced check's own term list uses (path term default +1, `bolt_grip_11` sign -1). No sign is authored anywhere in this file; both come off the graph.

This study reproduces stack path `clamped_stack_sourced` (bushing + pitch-plate lug + washer) as a strict subset of its own selection -- the three clamped edges alone, walked head-to-tail, are exactly that path's own term list.
